description: Search eligible published offers across AgentSynta without a slug using literal keywords or conservative buyer criteria; returns applied criteria and stored match evidence, never FX or distance estimates.

bedrooms.description: Exact affirmative bedroom count from description or Bedrooms attribute, never inferred from Rooms=3+2.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code; £ implies GBP, € implies EUR; bare $ requires explicit currency.

cursor.description: Use next_cursor from the previous page (works at any depth).

location.description: Textual offering locality or business city/region/country, e.g. London, Sydney or New York; never a distance claim. Only the alias groups Nicosia/Lefkoşa/Lefkosa/Nicossia and North Cyprus/NC are normalised.

max_price.description: Inclusive maximum price; currency required. Conflicting inferred budgets are rejected.

min_price.description: Inclusive minimum price; currency required. No FX conversion.

offset.description: Use next_offset from the previous page.

q.description: Alias of query; conflicting aliases are rejected.

query.description: Literal search text; budget and bedroom phrases are understood, e.g. 'three bedroom home under £500,000'. Put the place in location (e.g. London), not in the query. Unsupported residual words remain literal constraints.

name: search_all_offerings
title: Search all offerings
